metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the three ruled pages, Sadler's three sentences, and a ledger line for the five pounds.

yesterday: Forty-one shillings, forty-four and sixpence, fourteen and sixpence. Five pounds. The pages are ruled.
Forty-two shillings came out of the sixty. Eighteen are sewn back in.
Sadler called the morning eight loaves.
Tomorrow you walk to Shottery with her. The canvas goes in your hand, sewn.
